title: The blue pencil, sharpened
logline: The blue pencil on the drafting table, sharpened to a point it won't need, the shavings in a curl beside it, the ruler put away. A week after the first ungridded page; the habit outlives the grid by a week.

panels.composition: Close on a blue pencil freshly sharpened on a drafting table with a curl of shavings beside it and no ruler in sight, a blank sheet beneath.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on a freshly sharpened blue pencil on a drafting table with a curl of shavings beside it and a blank sheet beneath, no ruler, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The habit outlives the grid by a week.
